instructions: The purchasing flow is plan, then execute, then external checkout. Polling is the only continuation method; use order(orderHandle) for payment and fulfilment. Never prefix mattanutra_dev or any server name onto short tool names. Discover info and tools/list; agree provisional nutrient targets; create a plan; review important advice and distinct options; refine explicitly; confirm the exact current option and revision with the customer; execute; open external checkout; poll order until terminal. Ready means technically purchasable, never medically approved. Nutrient limits, interactions and missing health information are advisory and require no safety acknowledgement. Unknown intake is not zero; a repetitive diet is not a diagnosis. An algae-named omega-3 target implies algae_only; vegan also requires algae omega-3, and fish DHA/EPA is wrong_source. Vitamin K2, MK-7 and Menaquinone-7 resolve through supported explicit catalogue aliases; a specific EPA or DHA target is never replaced by a broad omega-3 family. The supported dose search is a zero-new-products baseline or 1–3 whole catalogue servings per product per day; this is a computational search domain, never a medical maximum. Every objective first minimises symmetric target under/over deviation, normalized newly added dose above a known continued-dose reference for unrequested nutrients, plus 2× upper-limit excess. Estimated or unknown current doses do not create that reference. Trimmed alternative searches are incomplete, not proof no alternative exists. Keep the requested constraints and never silently substitute products. The seven short tool names are info, plan, execute, order, support, feedback, evidence. Use only these documented short tool names. Responsibility boundaries follow responsibility-4.0.0. Read evidence with the returned evidenceHandle to review supporting claims and limitations. The full schema and working examples are available through resources/read. Guide: mattanutra://contract/4.0.0/client-guide. Schema: mattanutra://contract/4.0.0/schema. DEV uses Stripe Test Mode; explicit customer confirmation of the exact current option/revision is required before execute. Feedback remains optional and requires explicit consent.

tools.description: MattaNutra matches real products to agreed nutrient targets, optimising overlap, current stock and cost. Safety advice follows responsibility-4.0.0 boundaries; it provides wellness guidance, not diagnosis, pharmacy services or clinical advice.
tools.name: info

tools.description: Create, get, revise, answer or select agreed nutrient targets. Read each operation schema. revise.request replaces the request; revise.requestPatch merges objects and replaces arrays, [] clears, null is invalid. requirements.excludeProductIds rejects one product; excludeSupplementIds excludes a nutrient. Health concerns are serious advice and never require acknowledgement. Unknown profile/intake is allowed. Preserve constraints and confirm the selected revision before execute.

request.description: Complete plan request. Replacement revisions reset omitted optional fields. Agreed targets are not diagnoses. Resolved nutrient amounts must represent at least one nanogram, one CFU, or 0.001 ml/serving; IU precision depends on nutrient form. Below-precision errors report the exact field and permitted minimum.
